findings.evidence: Line 16: “This file identifies it: it is a version of the conditional expectation…”; theorem `Contractable.exists_tailProcess_measurable_cesaroLimit` concludes only `Measurable[tailProcess X] a`, `MemLp a 1 μ`, and L¹ convergence.
findings.fix: Replace the identification claim with the accurate statement that this file proves the limit has a tail-measurable representative, reserving conditional-expectation identification for the complementary result.
findings.issue: The module docstring says the file identifies the limit as a conditional expectation of the initial observable, but the only main theorem proves existence of a tail-measurable Cesàro limit; lines 19 and 36–40 acknowledge that the identification is not proved here.

summary: The module docstring overstates the file’s result by claiming an identification that it explicitly leaves to a later contribution.
